checks.title: MongoDB version reported (>= 5.0)
checks.rationale: Pre-5.0 releases no longer receive security patches from MongoDB Inc.
checks.remediation: Plan an in-place upgrade to MongoDB 6.0 LTS or 7.0.

checks.title: Access control (authorization) is enabled
checks.rationale: Without auth, anyone reaching the mongod port has full database access.
checks.remediation: Set security.authorization: enabled in mongod.conf, create root user, and restart mongod.

checks.title: TLS is required for client connections
checks.rationale: Without TLS, credentials and BSON payloads traverse the network in cleartext.
checks.remediation: Set net.tls.mode: requireTLS and provide certificateKeyFile in mongod.conf.

checks.title: Server-side JavaScript execution is disabled
checks.rationale: Server-side JavaScript ($where, mapReduce) is a known RCE pivot in injection scenarios.

checks.title: mongod does not bind to 0.0.0.0 / wildcard interface
checks.rationale: Binding to 0.0.0.0 exposes mongod to every reachable network interface.
checks.remediation: Set net.bindIp to specific interface IPs (or 127.0.0.1 for single-host).

checks.title: Auditing is configured (auditLog destination present)
checks.rationale: Audit logs are required for change tracking and forensic investigation.
checks.remediation: Configure auditLog.destination=file (or syslog) in mongod.conf - Enterprise feature.

checks.title: Manual: review user roles for least-privilege
checks.audit: Run 'db.getUsers()' on admin and each tenant database. Confirm app users have scoped roles (e.g., readWrite on one DB) rather than root or dbAdminAnyDatabase.
checks.rationale: Overprivileged users widen blast radius of credential compromise.
checks.remediation: Recreate users with role-scoped privileges using db.createUser({...roles: [{role:'readWrite', db:'appdb'}]}).

checks.title: Manual: confirm replica set / sharded cluster requires keyFile or x.509 auth
checks.audit: Inspect security.keyFile or security.clusterAuthMode in each member's mongod.conf. Confirm internal authentication is enforced for all replica-set/sharded members.
checks.rationale: Without keyFile/x.509, any host reaching the replication port can join the set.
checks.remediation: Generate a shared keyFile (chmod 400) and reference it in security.keyFile on every member.

checks.title: Manual: verify Encryption at Rest (WiredTiger encryption or filesystem LUKS)
checks.audit: Check security.enableEncryption (Enterprise) or confirm the data volume backing dbPath is LUKS / native cloud-disk encryption.
checks.rationale: Cleartext data files expose all collections if storage is breached.
checks.remediation: Enable WiredTiger encryption with KMIP/Vault key management, or migrate to encrypted disks.

checks.title: Manual: backup encryption and retention policy
checks.audit: Confirm mongodump / Ops Manager / Cloud backup output is encrypted at rest and retained per policy.
checks.rationale: Unencrypted backups defeat at-rest encryption protections.
checks.remediation: Use encrypted backup destinations and validate restore drills.
